subject.title: fix(whatsapp): normalize hosted JIDs consistently with Baileys

question: Should upgrades with legacy WhatsApp LID-form allowlists fail closed unless the plugin can prove a unique persisted LID-to-PN mapping, with unresolved entries retained and surfaced through `openclaw doctor --fix` warnings?
rationale: This is an authorization-policy and upgrade-contract choice: source review can confirm the branch implements the stated behavior, but it cannot decide whether affected operators should lose access until manual repair rather than retain legacy authorization semantics.

options.title: Accept verified-only migration
options.body: Approve the fail-closed policy, require the owner to confirm the operator recovery wording and upgrade coverage, and merge only after the exact head’s required checks complete.

options.title: Preserve legacy authorization temporarily
options.body: Keep legacy LID allowlist behavior through an explicitly documented compatibility path, which would require a different supported authorization contract and validation plan.

options.title: Pause for broader policy review
options.body: Defer this large identity refactor until WhatsApp authorization, mapping persistence, and upgrade expectations have a narrower maintainer-approved design.

recommendation.title: Accept verified-only migration
recommendation.body: Approve the fail-closed policy, require the owner to confirm the operator recovery wording and upgrade coverage, and merge only after the exact head’s required checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author implemented the JID model and its doctor migration safeguards, making them the best available technical owner to clarify the intended policy for maintainer approval.
